Do not make a nutrition KPI dashboard the primary surface.
Do not add persistent bottom navigation merely because the page is mobile.
Do not duplicate one food decision into rigid lunch/dinner forms without a new explicit reason.
Do not allow overlapping mobile panels, unreachable controls, clipped tactile shadows, dead click targets or nutrient bars that dominate the viewport.
Do not publish personal food lists, consumption history, health context or LOCAL payloads into public recovery artifacts.
Do not infer Current/Human Accepted/Served from a remembered filename or a higher version number.
Do not relabel the R08 reconstruction as the historical V12.2 or as a recovered accepted demo.
